title: Pauzes + eventlog per rit, verwijderen = prullenbak, terugzetten

steps.name: pauze met reden, klok-tijd > rijtijd, eventlog op de server
steps.assert: fetch('/api/vbt/rides?limit=200',{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('hp_token')}}).then(r=>r.json()).then(a => a.find(r => r.clientId === window.__cid)).then(r => { window.__id = r.id; return r.pauses.some(p => p.reason === 'paused' && p.dur >= 3) && r.elapsed >= r.duration + 3 }).then(ok => ok && fetch('/api/vbt/rides/' + window.__id, {headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('hp_token')}}).then(r => r.json()).then(d => d.events.length > 0))

steps.name: weg uit de lijst, in de prullenbak
steps.assert: fetch('/api/vbt/rides?limit=200',{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('hp_token')}}).then(r=>r.json()).then(a => !a.some(r => r.clientId === window.__cid)).then(ok => ok && fetch('/api/vbt/rides-trash',{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('hp_token')}}).then(r=>r.json()).then(t => t.some(r => r.clientId === window.__cid)))

steps.name: TRASH toont de rit met RESTORE
